_comment: Coverage universe of the Hyperscaler Hub (owner's choice, 2026-10-03): the six core companies with full filings-based data and the listed neocloud tier. fyEnd is the fiscal-year-end month (1-12). group: core | neocloud. Private counterparties (OpenAI, Anthropic, Crusoe, Lambda) are not covered companies; they appear only as counterparties in modules 6-7. Filer category and forms come from the EDGAR submissions API on every run, never from this file.

companies.note_en: Foreign private issuer: annual report on Form 20-F (XBRL); quarterly results are furnished on Form 6-K without XBRL, so quarterly figures are not in the automated feed.
